finding.title: Late staker steals pre-join rewards
finding.description: stake() changes staked/totalStaked without the update(msg.sender) checkpoint, so a new staker's userRewardPerTokenPaid stays 0 and they can claim rewards accrued before they joined.
finding.attack: Wait for rewards to accrue, stake, then claim in the same block.

patch.note: Checkpoint the account before changing its stake (add update modifier)
